newsitem.title: THAILAND: TelecomAsia says 1.1 mln phones connected.
newsitem.headline: TelecomAsia says 1.1 mln phones connected.

text.p: Thai telephone operator, TelecomAsia Plc said on Wednesday the company had connected 1.1 million lines to households from 2.6 million lines already installed.
The revenue from the connected lines was worth about 700 baht per line per month, TelecomAsia said in a statement.
TelecomAsia has received a government's concession to install and operate 2.6 million telephone lines in Bangkok and nearby provinces.
The company said it plans to develop Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) system to provide multimedia service via its telephone lines.
